text:
Maya Patel: Heads-up 1: NorthStar reserved pool goes live 06:00 PT tomorrow. Need final decisions on quota carve (steady vs burst), autoscale ramp profile, and whether to exclude analytics-heavy routes from the burst template. @Carlos Reed can you confirm?
Carlos Reed: I pulled their historical patterns. Committed 70k tokens/min. Suggest baseline 52.5k (75%) + 17.5k burst for first 72h. Exclude /batch/async and /ingest from burst; keep admin and webhook paths unthrottled.
Olivia (CSM): Customer sign-off 1: they agreed to 25% buffer for 72h, but requested that billing flags show "bring-up buffer" and not count toward overage while we monitor. Also asked for a 10-min post-run sync each morning.
Carlos Reed: I'll schedule two noise-model runs tonight: (A) 20m prefix priming, (B) 10m steady at baseline, (C) 2m controlled spike to 72k. Including KV priming and cold-checks. k6 snippet below for the spike.
Carlos Reed: ```
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model:'rw-dedicated-13b', prompt:'warmup'}), { headers: {'Authorization':'Bearer $TEST'} });
  sleep(1);
}
```
qa-bot: Job queued by Carlos Reed: job_id=ns-warm-9001, start=2024-05-10T01:30:00Z, runner=k6-3.3
Carlos Reed: Quick note on autoscale params: aggressive scale-up (target window 30s) until pool reaches 80% utilization, then normalize to 90s cool-down. If p95 > 300ms for >90s, trigger fallback routing (5% traffic to rq-quantized).
Maya Patel: Ops checklist 1: (1) apply 75/25 steady/burst carve, (2) ensure /batch/async and /ingest are soft-throttled during spikes, (3) enable KV priming pre-run, (4) tag metrics with "bringup:NorthStar". Assign @Carlos Reed + @Olivia (CSM).
Olivia (CSM): I confirmed the billing flag with Finance 1: bring-up buffer will be not billed for overage for the first 72h; we'll surface an annotated invoice line after the period. Sent invites for daily 10-min check. Also posted feedback form: https://forms.gle/northstar-warmup
qa-bot: Run completed: peak=74k rps (40s spike), avg=58k, errors=1.1% (mostly 429 on excluded batch endpoints), p95=295ms. Artifacts: https://internal.redwood/jobs/ns-warm-9001/logs
Carlos Reed: Observed cache hit-rate 66% -> 91% after priming. 429s concentrated on /batch/async as expected. No 5xx. Will implement route-level soft-throttles to divert or queue batch jobs.
Maya Patel: Thanks 1 Action items recap: (A) apply 30s aggressive scale-up and 90s cool-down per Carlos' note, (B) enable soft-throttles on batch routes, (C) start 5% graceful diversion to quantized variant as fallback, (D) send daily health digest to customer. Re-assign @Carlos Reed + @Olivia (CSM).
Olivia (CSM): Done 1 invites and digest configured. Customer requested a short summary for their renewal evaluation after 72h1 will prepare and share.
Maya Patel: Great 1 reconvene after 72h for post-mortem and renewal readiness. :white_check_mark:
